World Drowning Prevention Day observed with safety awareness

World Drowning Prevention Day was observed with various events aimed at raising awareness about water safety. Organizations conducted demonstrations and issued advisories, particularly highlighting the dangers of alcohol consumption near water bodies. The focus was on preventing drowning incidents through education and responsible behavior.
